top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is the one shortlisted achievement that is both completely new and already consequential: induced proximity replaces occupancy-driven pharmacology with event-driven removal, is quantitatively testable (ternary-complex cooperativity, degradation kinetics) and has been reproduced widely for over two decades. Adding Handa ties the PROTAC concept to the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide-type degraders, the one place where induced proximity is already a clinical fact, within three names. If the glue strand is judged separate, I prefer the PROTAC-only P005 over forced combinations; no-award is ranked last.
